profile.network: 4 Mbps down / 1 Mbps up / 100 ms RTT

interactions.method: Synthetic click to two animation frames, healthy local browser after load; includes frame wait

durableCommands.method: Playwright click to Saved label after IndexedDB transaction, healthy local storage; includes automation overhead

browserDurableCommands.method: Captured DOM click to observed Working then Saved label; same ten commands, in-page clock, CPU throttle removed after cold load. Excludes Playwright actionability/IPC; still a lab measurement.

limits: Linux Chromium lab measurement only. No reference physical phone or iPad; not a physical-device acceptance result. Long-task and actual touchscreen latency require device profiling.
